Direct volume rendering is the most standard rendering mode. It sends rays through the dataset, and uses "transfer functions" (1D or 2D) to determine the colour and opacity. Transfer functions map density (2D: also gradient magnitude) to a colour and opacity. Modifying transfer functions: Click "Volume Rendering" in the menu bar and select "1D Transfer Function" or "2D Transfer Function" 1D ...
